summary: Completed and durably recorded all 12/12 pending home-active audit items. Geometry is healthy, but page ownership mismatch is 12.796% versus the 8.5% threshold. No implementation or source files were changed.
issues: Hero typography, CTA placement and slider controls differ from the source; benefits also use the wrong warranty icon and incorrect typography.
Crop selection omits source entries and active popovers. Promotions, bundles and recommended products lack carousel controls; bundle media and content layout materially diverge.
Catalogues, about, blog and knowledge sections retain substantial crop, spacing, typography or accordion-state defects documented in their checkpoints.
Responsive product and blog wrappers shift off-screen at 1440–375 px; mobile renders lose major content and 375 px retains one pixel of overflow.

Fresh isolated Chrome testing found no runtime errors, but crop items are plain links, quantities have no interactive controls, product carousels expose no controls, and the knowledge accordion permits multiple open panels without swapping state icons.
